single.rationale: Edgewell faces deteriorating fundamentals with revenue declining, operating income collapsing 52% year-over-year to $96.6M (4.3% margin), and net income plummeting 74% to $25.4M. The company operates in structurally challenged categories (wet shave, disposables) with intensifying competitive pressures, particularly in North America which declined 4.4% organically. While management highlights productivity initiatives and cost savings, gross margin compression (80bps), significant restructuring charges ($53M in FY25, $49M expected in FY26), and continued volume declines suggest ongoing struggles
